description: Wrap zod validation errors in user-friendly readable messages
rules: For zod v4 import from 'zod-validation-error'. For zod v3 import from 'zod-validation-error/v3'. The two entry points are not interchangeable.

zod v4 uses the createErrorMap() factory, registered with zod.config({ customError: createErrorMap() }). zod v3 uses the static errorMap export, registered with zod.setErrorMap(errorMap). Neither the export nor the registration call is shared between them.
createMessageBuilder accepts forceTitleCase only on the zod v4 entry point.
README.md documents the zod v4 API and README.v3.md documents the zod v3 API. Both are current. Never combine examples from the two.
